study.question: Can a target-conditioned diagonal projection of the existing count-shrunk historical feedback moments improve four-task validation macro ROC-AUC over the incumbent and both frozen source bests at unchanged parameter count and justified measured compute? Does any effect depend on retaining event-content/feedback pairing rather than products of means?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the relation-content source scores 0.8275704846 macro AUC and count-shrink source 0.8272805337; the incumbent centered joint residual scores 0.8280959705. Its residual content map W is independent of target embeddings within category/brand membership, whereas the core already has target-dependent DIN weights. The current source was verified against incumbent SHA256 06cd879a5619936c12858a8eac8d8db5937aca08be72c412a2f00adda4bcccba before editing. Replacing that residual map by W diag(1+tanh(q_target)) may expose target-specific directions of event/feedback association that the fixed eight-dimensional projection otherwise conflates. A matched history-conditioned diagonal map tests whether target information is useful beyond generic sample-dependent scaling. Count shrinkage and visible-user centering remain fixed; this is a conditional representation hypothesis, not calibrated confidence, independent-prior inference, event retrieval, causal evidence or an originality claim.

study.proposed_difference: For valid history keys x_i in R^96 and target q in the same item-field order, use x_i_prime=x_i*(1+tanh(q_ref)), where q_ref is either the current target or the masked visible-history mean. Use transformed keys only in the residual mean and covariance; the core keys/values, routing, fractions, counts, action embeddings and readouts remain unchanged. Both references and gates are computed in every arm. The same map supplies mean and covariance. Cross target/history conditioning with joint/factorized moments in four standalone modules; both covariance computations execute, with coupling1 or0. Since modulation is constant across events, this is exactly a sample-dependent linear projection before W in real arithmetic, not an event-specific attention rule. The unsubmitted conditioning_mode=none exists only for host source-parity diagnostics.
